correctness.rationale: The four-corner Walsh expansion c+uσ1+vσ2+wσ1σ2 gives variance u²+v²+w². Scalar Lipschitz constraints for all six Euclidean corner pairs reduce exactly to p+r≤a/2, q+r≤b/2, p+q≤√(a²+b²)/2 with p,q,r absolute. The convex-in-r piecewise quadratic attains maximum at r=0, p=a/2, q=(√(a²+b²)−a)/2 (plus symmetric permutation at square). For Hilbert vectors, opposite-edge parallelogram bounds give ||u||²+||v||²+||w||²≤(a²+b²)/4−||w||²; equality demands w=0 and perpendicular u,v by diagonal inequalities. The relative loss is strictly increasing in t=b/a and is √2−1 at t=1. Source exact-radical vertex checker inspects ten ratios (84 vertices), not a universal proof.
